name: Drawmij's Instant Summons

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Mark an object so that crushing the sapphire brings it to your hand.
text: The object weighs 10 pounds or less and is no longer than 6 feet. If someone else holds it, you instead learn who and roughly where they are.
